vavau-1.text: bio: second-largest town in Tonga, Port of Refuge harbour, ~3,800 residents

vavau-2.text: bio: sea cave reached by boat, entered via underwater tunnel

vavau-2.fix: Wikivoyage says only '$50 per person' for a shared day trip (also covers Swallows Cave and beaches), currency not stated. Pricing is for the boat trip, not the cave; keep as tour 'about 50' marked approximate, or leave unpriced.

vavau-3.text: bio: reached by boat, excellent snorkelling

vavau-3.fix: Same shared day-trip '$50' as Mariners Cave; currency not stated, not cave-specific.

vavau-4.text: bio: 35 min by boat from Neiafu, sheltered bays, humpbacks with calves
bio variant 3: whales gather each season

vavau-4.fix: Not a Hunga price: it is the generic day-trip figure; no per-visitor fee for the island is sourced. Use free: true, costBasis open (no entry fee), or leave unpriced.

vavau-5.text: bio: ~5 min boat from Neiafu; second-largest island of the group; land bridge to 'Utu Vava'u; beaches and snorkelling

vavau-5.fix: No fee found anywhere; open access is a reasonable default but not positively sourced.

vavau-6.text: bio: established 1995, entrance ~2 km from Neiafu, ~1 km trail, steep 10-20 min climb to lookout

vavau-6.fix: Re-read fresh: page lists it as a Free Activity. No fee on Wikivoyage. Lonely Planet conflict not seen.

vavau-7.fix: Sources say 'first of its kind' in Tonga, not only. Use variant 2 or 3.

vavau-7.text: bio: largest and most varied plant collection in Tonga; Tu'anekivale, east coast; visitors' centre with tapa and kava; guided tour

vavau-7.fix: Fresh read: the operator's tour (1.5 h guided) is listed at NZ$110 per person on a third-party booker page (a 55 figure appears beside it, not labelled adult). No source gives TOP 35-55. Wikivoyage lists no price. Mark price unverified, or use NZ$110 if the owner accepts the booker as the garden's own price (then currency NZD); do not ship TOP 35-55.
The tour page above is a booker, not the garden's own site; none verified.
